purpose: Machine-readable adjudication specification for P14E. The harness adjudicator interprets this ordered rule table to assign the protected gold disposition of every generated case. Policy arms never receive this object or its output; they receive case facts only.
rule_evaluation: first rule whose condition predicate holds wins; conditions are stated over the eight case facts

rules.condition: not evidence_integrity or not frozen_protocol or not identifiable
rules.rationale: admissibility screening fails: the record cannot be scientifically adjudicated
nearest donor fully owns the proposed residual
evidence supports only a joint interaction, not a standalone atom
putative positive is a same-evidence rereading of a live negative/subsumed history
valid, identifiable, prospectively frozen standalone residual with no unreopened negative-history conflict

stratum_free_coordinates.comment: Per stratum, the coordinates that the generator remints uniformly without changing the protected disposition (gold short-circuits before reading them, or the stratum pins them to the value the rule table requires). Every other coordinate is pinned by the stratum. The reminting verification gate requires both boolean values of every listed free coordinate to occur in every family-by-stratum cell.

CANNOT_CHECK.pinned: at least one of evidence_integrity/frozen_protocol/identifiable is false (failing subset reminted uniformly over the 7 nonempty subsets)
